title: Lola's emotional post, Jorge Lanata's daughter, four months after the death
text:
ARGENTINA
Lola's emotional post, Jorge Lanata's daughter, four months after the death
The daughter of the renowned host made a post on Instagram in which she fondly remembered her dad
Four months after the passing of Jorge Lanata, his youngest daughter,Lola Lanata, continues to pay tribute to him in an intimate and emotional way on her social media. This time, the young photographer shared an unpublished childhood image with the renowned journalist, accompanied by a message filled with nostalgia:"I miss you a little more every day", she wrote, closing the text with a red heart.
The post, which quickly caused hundreds of reactions and supportive comments, shows a heartwarming scene from the family album. In the photo, Lanata appears sitting on a bench while tenderly embracing a young Lola, dressed in a red and white striped dress. The image reflects a deep emotional bond and a connection that transcends the passage of time.
This is not the first time Lola has publicly honored her father since his passing. In March, she shared a homemade video where both attempt to coordinate a TikTok choreography. Amidst laughter and improvised steps, the clip reveals the more playful and human side of the journalist, who was known for his strong character and firm stances in the media. In that video, they are seen enjoying a spontaneous moment, full of complicity and joy.
Already in January, just a month after the death of the host of PPT (Periodismo Para Todos), Lola had published an intimate snapshot in which they both embraced during a family dinner. The image was accompanied by a brief but emotional text, confirming the deep bond that united them.
Lola's gestures do not go unnoticed. Her followers appreciate the way she keeps her father's memory alive, a central figure in Argentine journalism who left an indelible mark on the history of the media. Moreover, these posts offer a different perspective on Lanata, beyond the political analysis or the biting criticism that characterized him, they show the father.
Mourning, in digital times, also manifests in the form of posts, shared memories, and messages that capture the bond that was had. In the case of Lola Lanata, these expressions are also a testament to the love that remains beyond absence.
➡️ Argentina
